dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped features with high-intensity off-white perimeters. Edges are irregular and jagged, showing a sharp gradient shift from the dark grey exterior to the light perimeter, enclosing medium-grey interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid-intensity pixel clusters. High-intensity pixels are primarily confined to thin annular perimeters rather than solid, asymmetrical blobs.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest annuli in the dorsal-mid region form an approximate scalene triangle with the apex oriented toward the upper-left boundary.
